title: Daydreaming Dappled Cuttlefish
statement: This gentle cuttlefish drifts through a cozy, sun-dappled grotto of shell-books and glowing kelp, its skin rippling with constellations and question marks as it wonders. Now and then it puffs a tiny ink-cloud daydream, watches it bloom into a story, then happily rearranges its pebble library to match.
